resources.string: Android asks for this once. Komora installs only the apps in this list.
Every file is checked before installing: it must be signed with the key Komora knows for that app. A file signed by anyone else is refused.
Komora is free software under the GNU GPL 3.0, without any warranty. Uses AndroidX and Kotlin libraries (Apache 2.0). Apps are downloaded from GitHub.
No connection to GitHub. Try again later.
GitHub asks to wait a bit (too many checks). Try again in an hour.
The file could not be read as an app. Nothing was installed.
The file is a different app than expected. Nothing was installed.
The file is not signed with the expected key. Nothing was installed.
You already have this version or a newer one.
The installed copy was signed with a different key. Remove it first, then install from here.
Android did not install the app.
The latest release has no suitable app file.
